description: Where each committed DTD source came from. Both are the DTDs Qualys serves, without a credential, at the documented paths on the US1 platform host, saved byte for byte; nothing is typed. They replace copies taken from the XML/DTD reference PDF's /api/2.0 pages, which the served 6.0 and 4.0 outputs turned out to extend. The scheduled drift check fetches them again and compares (req-qualys-drift-ci). The reference PDF's hash is kept for the drift command's reference mode, for a platform that does not serve its DTDs.
source_version: Qualys API (VM, PC) XML/DTD Reference v10.25.1
